title: Eating protein before bed could help you build more muscle. 🌙💪
hook: Eating protein before bed could help you build more muscle. 🌙💪
caption:
Eating protein before bed could help you build more muscle. 🌙💪

A 2023 study found that consuming 45g of protein before sleep increased overnight muscle protein synthesis by ~28% compared with placebo.

But here’s the important part 👇

This doesn’t mean you need a huge protein shake before bed.

If you’re already hitting your daily protein target, training hard, and recovering properly, you’re covering the fundamentals.

Think of pre-bed protein as an extra opportunity to provide amino acids while you sleep, not a magic muscle-building hack.

title: Eating in a deficit doesn’t mean eating the same boring, dry food every day or cutting out everything you love.

caption:
Eating in a deficit doesn’t mean eating the same boring, dry food every day or cutting out everything you love.

It’s about making a few simple adjustments, being intentional with portions, and making room for the foods you actually enjoy.
